coran.intro: Reading (qāʿida), memorisation (hifẓ) and Quran player. Riwāya Ḥafṣ ʿan ʿĀṣim, exact Tanzil text.
coran.hifz_texte: Notebooks E1 (children) and N1 (adults): yearly plan, three tracks every day (new, recent, old), reviews at D+1, D+2, D+3, D+7, D+14, D+30, practice validation by a parent. The teacher remains the only judge; no ijāza.
coran.qaida_texte: Booklets qc1 to qc3: the letters and signs of the Medina Muṣḥaf, then the rules of recitation (tajwid), Ḥafṣ reading. The adult reads first, the learner repeats.
sciences.intro: Creed, fiqh (Mālikī school), life of the Prophet ﷺ, hadith and adab — the books of the Religion series.
sciences.re_texte: Levels re1 to re5: creed, sīra, prophets, fiqh, adab, supplications, hadith; practice log signed by a parent (never graded).
sciences.ra_texte: Levels ra1 to ra4, each published once frozen (the demo shows ra1 and ra2 as a preview): excerpts from Mālikī works, hadiths with their verified reference, case studies, tables, calculations.
sciences.fidelite: Everything shown comes from the books, exactly as written: the app adds no religious content.
ecriture.trace_texte: With a finger or a stylus: I trace over the dots, trace on the light letter, then write alone. The app checks the direction (right to left), the lane and the dots, and never gives a grade.
ecriture.en_attendant: The paper exercise book remains the main way to write: the app guides the movement, and the parent ticks “done in the book” in the lesson.
lectures.texte: Small graded books for each level: illustrated pages, foldable translation, “I understand”, “My words” and the “I read this book” stamp. Each booklet is offered after the lesson where the learner met its words; keep it on the device to read it without network.

gar.intro: What we promise, and how it is checked.
gar.contact: A question about these guarantees? Ask the school or the Awzid team.
gar.coran_titre: The Quran, exact to the sign
gar.coran: The Quran text comes only from the Tanzil reference text (riwāya Ḥafṣ ʿan ʿĀṣim). It is never retyped or corrected automatically.
gar.coran_preuve: Check: every verse of the books is compared byte for byte at each import; the hifẓ notebook, the reader and the tutor are tested the same way.
gar.hadiths: A hadith is quoted with its number only if it is in the register with the status “verified”. An unverified number is removed before reaching the phone.
gar.hadiths_preuve: Check: hadith register and automatic tests of the masking.
gar.ia: The tutor never writes the Quran, quotes no hadith outside the register and never gives religious rulings: it passes the question to the teacher. No free text before 13; for a child or teen, nothing without the parent's agreement.
gar.ia_preuve: Check: 1,081 “trap” tests and a fake malicious tutor, all blocked; the AI stays off until these tests are passed with the real model.
gar.voix: Recordings stay on the phone and are erased after 7 days. A family can choose to send one to the class teacher: encrypted, listened to by the teacher only, erased after a few days, deletable at any time. Never used to train an AI.
gar.voix_preuve: Check: sent only with the family's agreement (parent code for a child), encryption tested, access refused to any other account, automatic erasure; no other program reads the audio.
gar.traceurs: No advertising, no third-party advertising or analytics tracker. Fonts and content are served by Awzid.
gar.traceurs_preuve: Check: browser security policy that forbids external scripts.
gar.enfants: No streak to lose, no ranking, no virtual currency, no night notification, no faces in illustrations. The most protective settings are the defaults.
gar.enfants_preuve: Check: the parent sees the state of each protection (My account → Children's protections).
gar.recompenses: Only symbolic rewards (stamp, star, milestone): never random, never for sale, never compared.
gar.recompenses_preuve: Check: no shop or lottery in the app.
gar.paiement: Payment happens on the provider's secure page (card, mobile money, PayPal). Awzid never sees your card. The free trial asks for no payment method.
gar.paiement_preuve: Check: no card field in the app; payment messages are signed and verified.
gar.resiliation: My account → My subscription → “Stop the renewal”. Your rights last until the end of the paid period.
gar.donnees: No surname or email address for a child. Export and deletion of all your data from My account. Hosting planned in the European Union.
gar.donnees_preuve: Check: export and deletion tested; pseudonyms only.
gar.hors_ligne: A downloaded lesson works without network; your answers are sent when the network is back, with nothing lost or counted twice.

kh.consent_envoye: What is sent: a single notification per day, at the time you chose, simply saying it is time to read your portion. It contains no name, no progress and no number.
kh.consent_limites: It never arrives during your quiet hours, nor when your portion for the day is already read. Nothing else is sent, and nothing is shared with anyone.
kh.consent_arreter: To stop it, at any time: choose “No reminder” in the plan settings, or tap “Stop the daily reminder” in the same place, or turn off notifications in Account, Notifications. One step is enough.
kh.consent_enfant: For a child or a teen, a parent or guardian must agree. Without their agreement, there is no reminder.
